<!-- Hero Section -->
<div class="hero-section full-width" style="padding: 4rem 2rem;">
<div class="container">

# About Praevius: <span class="highlight">Programme Software from Construction Professionals</span>

<p class="tagline">Talk to your programme. Speak or type your changes, and see the result on screen.</p>

</div>
</div>

<!-- Story Section -->
<div class="section section-light">
<div class="container">

<h2 class="section-title">The <span>Story</span></h2>

<div style="max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.8;">

<p>Praevius (from Latin "praevius", meaning "going before") started with a simple observation: on most projects, the programme is the document everyone depends on and the fewest people can update.</p>

<p>After two decades working as quantity surveyors across the UK, Australia and Poland, we saw the same pattern on project after project. Subcontractors and site teams were held back by:</p>

<ul style="margin: 2rem 0;">
<li><strong>Desktop planning licences priced per user</strong>, so only one or two people in the company could open or change the programme</li>
<li><strong>Programmes arriving in different formats</strong>: MS Project from one main contractor, Asta Powerproject from the next, Primavera from a third</li>
<li><strong>Slow weekly updates</strong>: progress and date changes collected on site, then keyed in later by the one person with the software</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Praevius is our answer:</strong> construction programme software in the browser that you can talk to. Import the programme you already have, update it by voice or keyboard, check the critical path, and export it for MS Project or Primavera. One price for the company, with no per-user fees.</p>

</div>

</div>
</div>

<!-- How it works -->
<div class="section section-gray">
<div class="container">

<h2 class="section-title">Import, <span>Update by Voice</span>, Check, Export</h2>

<div style="max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.8;">

<p><strong>Import</strong> an MS Project, Asta Powerproject or Primavera file. It arrives as a new draft, with a report of what was carried and what was not.</p>

<p><strong>Update by voice</strong> or keyboard. Click the mic, say "push frame out a week", check the live transcript, and the change appears in the Gantt chart. Replies are on screen, and typing always works.</p>

<p><strong>Check</strong> the critical path, float and baseline comparison, and run Validate for open ends and negative float.</p>

<p><strong>Export</strong> for MS Project (XML) or Primavera (XER), or to PDF and Excel, with a report of anything that could not be carried.</p>

<p>See the full list on the <a href="features.html#programme">programme features</a> page.</p>

</div>

</div>
</div>

<!-- Who Uses Praevius -->
<div class="section section-light">
<div class="container">

<h2 class="section-title">Who Uses <span>Praevius?</span></h2>

<div class="grid-2">

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-tools"></i> Subcontractors</h3>
<p>Build and update your own package programme, and export it for the main contractor's MS Project or Primavera schedule.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i> Package Planners</h3>
<p>Import programmes from different main contractors in MS Project, Asta Powerproject or Primavera format, and work on them in one place.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-cone-striped"></i> Site Managers</h3>
<p>Record progress and move dates by speaking to the programme, without a desktop planning licence.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-building"></i> Small Main Contractors</h3>
<p>Run subcontractor and package programmes with critical path, baselines and progress, at one price for the company.</p>

Praevius suits subcontractor, package and mid-size main-contractor programmes of up to 2,000 tasks. It does not do resource or cost loading.

<!-- Philosophy Section -->
<div class="section section-gray">
<div class="container">

<h2 class="section-title">Our <span>Philosophy</span></h2>

<div class="grid-3">

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-person-gear"></i> AI Assists, You Decide</h3>
<p>The AI assistant does the typing and the checking. You review the result. Ordinary edits apply at once and can be undone; larger or destructive changes need your confirmation first.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-arrow-left-right"></i> Work with What You Have</h3>
<p>Import the MS Project, Asta or Primavera programme you already have. Import and export reports tell you exactly what could not be carried.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3><i class="bi bi-hand-thumbs-up"></i> Easy from Day One</h3>
<p>Runs in the browser with nothing to install. A keyboard grid like MS Project, drag-and-drop Gantt, undo and redo, and full history.</p>
</div>

</div>

</div>
</div>

<div class="section section-light">
<div class="container">

<h2 class="section-title">Frequently Asked <span>Questions</span></h2>

<div style="max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto;">

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>Who built Praevius?</h3>
<p>Praevius was built by quantity surveyors with 20 years in construction across the UK, Australia and Poland. The software comes from people who have worked with construction programmes, cost reports and progress claims on real projects.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>What is Praevius used for?</h3>
<p>Praevius is construction programme software you can talk to. You import your MS Project, Asta Powerproject or Primavera programme, update it by voice or keyboard in the browser, check the critical path and float, and export it for MS Project or Primavera. Cost control is a separate module on the same platform, on the Essential plan and above.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>Who is Praevius for?</h3>
<p>Subcontractors, package planners, site managers, small main contractors and QS practices. Praevius suits subcontractor, package and mid-size main-contractor programmes of up to 2,000 tasks. It does not do resource or cost loading.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>Does the AI change my programme without asking?</h3>
<p>Ordinary edits apply at once and you can undo them. Larger or destructive changes, such as deleting more than 10 tasks, imports, restores or deleting a programme, are proposed first and run only when you confirm.</p>
</div>

<div class="faq-item">
<h3>Is Praevius related to BIM Takeoff?</h3>
<p>Yes. Praevius is the programme and cost platform of the BIM Takeoff ecosystem. BIM Takeoff (bimtakeoff.com) provides quantity takeoff and estimating services.</p>
</div>

</div>

</div>
</div>
